intervals.label: proposed (conceptual and technical design reports)
intervals.locator: arXiv:2102.00442 abstract (CDR, 31 Jan 2021); arXiv:2404.08317 (TDR, April 2024); 64th PAC PP report (June 2026)
intervals.note: Status proposed: the collaboration "proposes to install" the detector at the second NICA interaction point (SPD website, TDR). In June 2026 JINR says all efforts are focused on creating the experimental facility and infrastructure for the first phase, with the magnet-yoke contract still to be concluded and prototype beam-beam counters and zero-degree calorimeters to be installed during the next NICA run.
intervals.quote: proposed to be placed in one of the two interaction points of the NICA collider that is under construction at the Joint Institute for Nuclear Research (Dubna, Russia)

placements.note: Planned location at the second NICA interaction point; campus-grade accelerator-complex point.
placements.quote: The Spin Physics Detector collaboration proposes to install a universal detector in the second interaction point of the NICA collider under construction (JINR, Dubna)

summary.plain: A planned universal detector with a thousand-tonne magnet yoke, a superconducting magnet and silicon, straw-tube, calorimeter and particle-identification subsystems to be placed at the second NICA collision point.
summary.technical: SPD: superconducting solenoid with a thousand-tonne yoke (contract pending June 2026), silicon vertex detector, straw tracker, time-of-flight, electromagnetic calorimeter, muon system and beam-beam counters / zero-degree calorimeters.

technology.value: Universal detector for polarised-beam collisions at the second NICA interaction point
